articles.title: FEC Design Trends for 2027: From Attraction Mix to Social Destination
articles.summary: Industry analyst ESAC draws on the Shanghai WUNPARK case study to outline key FEC design trends heading into 2027, emphasizing the shift from attraction-led venues to socially-driven destinations. The analysis is essential reading for operators planning new builds or renovations, as the social destination model is reshaping guest expectations and revenue strategies globally. FEC developers and investors should pay close attention to how attraction mix and placemaking are evolving.

articles.title: Level99's Disney Springs Venue Signals New Era for Adult Social Gaming FECs
articles.summary: Matt DuPlessie's Level99 Entertainment has opened its most ambitious venue yet at Disney Springs, Walt Disney World, combining dozens of physical and mental challenges with technology, art, and food and beverage in a format that blurs the line between arcade, escape room, and social entertainment. The concept's continued expansion demonstrates strong consumer demand for replayable, socially competitive real-world gaming experiences. FEC operators should watch Level99 closely as a blueprint for adult-oriented, high-dwell-time venue design.

articles.title: Level99 Sets Opening Date for West Hartford Location
articles.summary: Level99, the adult social gaming playground concept, has announced an opening date for its West Hartford, Connecticut venue, marking another step in the brand's regional expansion. The opening adds to Level99's growing footprint outside its Massachusetts home market and signals continued investor and operator confidence in the competitive socializing format. FEC operators should note the brand's rapid multi-market growth as a bellwether for the social entertainment category.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Adding Large Family Entertainment Center at South Plains Mall
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is expanding its South Plains Mall footprint with a massive new family entertainment center, reflecting the broader trend of cinema operators diversifying into FEC attractions to drive traffic and revenue. The move underscores how traditional entertainment venues are pivoting to mixed-use FEC models to remain competitive. Mall-based FEC operators should track this expansion as an example of cinema-FEC hybrid development.

articles.title: Sesame Workshop Expanding FEC Footprint with China Deal and New U.S. Locations
articles.summary: Sesame Workshop's senior director of global themed entertainment Michelle Kreher is overseeing a significant expansion of the brand's FEC presence, including a multi-year agreement to develop Sesame Street family entertainment centers in China and new U.S. locations such as Sesame Street Learn & Play at American Dream. The strategy of anchoring FECs with trusted children's IP offers a proven model for driving family visitation and repeat visits. FEC operators and developers considering IP licensing partnerships will find the Sesame approach instructive.

articles.title: TwinkleTwinkleStar and Ventola Projects Partner to Upgrade Party Room Entertainment with LED and AV Tech
articles.summary: TwinkleTwinkleStar has announced a collaboration with UK-based Ventola Projects to transform traditional FEC party rooms into immersive, revenue-generating attractions using interactive LED lighting, wireless audio, and optional video displays. The patent-pending multisensory system is designed to give operators a low-footprint, high-impact upgrade to an often-underutilized revenue center. FEC operators looking to maximize party room ROI should evaluate this technology.

articles.title: New Greek FEC Selects Sacoa Cashless Payment System
articles.summary: A newly opened family entertainment center in Greece has chosen Sacoa's cashless payment and management platform, highlighting continued international adoption of card and app-based payment systems in the FEC sector. Cashless systems are increasingly standard for new FEC builds as operators seek to improve guest spend, reduce cash handling, and gather actionable data. This deployment offers a useful reference point for operators evaluating cashless technology vendors.

articles.title: Complete Sports and Management India Wins Two New FEC Projects
articles.summary: India-based Complete Sports and Management (BSE: CSML) has secured contracts for two new FEC projects, signaling growing momentum for the family entertainment center industry in the Indian market. The wins reflect rising consumer demand for organized indoor entertainment in emerging markets. Suppliers and investors tracking global FEC expansion should note India as an increasingly active development market.

articles.title: 'Masha and the Three Bears' Launches First Branded Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: The popular children's IP 'Masha and the Three Bears' is entering the location-based entertainment space with its first family entertainment center, expanding the brand's physical presence beyond media. IP-anchored FECs continue to attract strong family audiences and can differentiate venues in competitive markets. FEC operators and developers considering IP partnerships should watch this rollout for performance benchmarks.

articles.title: Construction Underway on Two New Hello Park Locations
articles.summary: Hello Park, an indoor family entertainment park concept, has begun construction on two new locations, indicating active expansion for the brand. The simultaneous multi-site build-out suggests strong operator confidence and capital backing in the indoor FEC sector. Competitors and suppliers should monitor Hello Park's rollout for insights into site selection, attraction mix, and construction timelines.

articles.title: Fond Memories Drive Redevelopment of Wisconsin Bowling Alley
articles.summary: A bowling alley in Ozaukee County, Wisconsin is being reborn, fueled by community nostalgia and local investment in a revitalized entertainment destination. The story reflects a broader trend of bowling venue reinvention, with operators modernizing legacy facilities to attract new and returning guests. Bowling center operators considering renovation projects will find this a relatable case study in community-driven FEC redevelopment.

articles.title: Pensacola's New Pelican Indoor Entertainment Complex Opens
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment complex called The Pelican has opened in Pensacola, Florida, adding a multi-attraction venue to the region's leisure landscape. New venue openings of this type provide useful benchmarks for FEC operators on attraction mix, branding, and market positioning in mid-sized U.S. cities. Regional FEC developers should take note of how new entrants are designing all-in-one entertainment destinations.

articles.title: Beloit Pub Adds Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Traffic
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit has installed indoor golf simulators to attract guests during the slower winter season, illustrating how food-and-beverage operators are adding FEC-style attractions to boost revenue and dwell time. This trend of simulator golf integration into hospitality venues is a growing competitive consideration for standalone FEC operators. Bowling centers and FECs with bars should evaluate golf simulation as a complementary attraction to existing offerings.

articles.title: First Permanent U.S. teamLab Museum to Open at Southern California's OCVIBE
articles.summary: TeamLab, the Japanese digital art collective, will open its first permanent U.S. museum as part of the OCVIBE mixed-use entertainment district in Southern California, joining a curated mix of entertainment, dining, and hospitality. The move signals growing mainstream viability of immersive digital art as an anchor attraction in large-scale entertainment developments. FEC operators and venue developers should consider how immersive art concepts are influencing guest expectations for experiential entertainment.

articles.title: Path Entertainment Group Scales IP-Based Competitive Socializing with Monopoly, Paddington, and SAW Experiences
articles.summary: David Hutchinson's Path Entertainment Group continues to expand its portfolio of IP-based location-based entertainment experiences, including Monopoly Lifesized in London and Riyadh, The Paddington Bear Experience, and SAW: Escape Experience, with an expanded Hasbro licensing deal signaling further growth. The group's Gamepath division exemplifies the competitive socializing model that is reshaping urban entertainment venues. FEC operators evaluating escape room, immersive, or competitive socializing concepts should study Path's IP-driven expansion strategy.

articles.title: Acesso Intelligence Launches AI Platform with 100+ Decision Skills for Attraction Operators
articles.summary: Acesso Intelligence has introduced a library of over 100 AI-powered Decision Skills spanning leadership, finance, marketing, membership, operations, guest experience, retail, food and beverage, and risk management for attraction and FEC operators. The platform promises to bring data-driven decision-making tools to venue management teams without requiring deep technical expertise. FEC operators looking to improve operational efficiency and revenue performance through AI should evaluate this platform.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Expands Destination Experience Business, Names New Chief Growth Officer
articles.summary: Orlando-based Memoir Creative has announced a major expansion of its client services division and appointed Kevin Kreczko, a former RWS Global and Bass Pro Shops executive, as Chief Growth Officer to lead growth across theme parks, cruise lines, and destination experiences. The expansion of integrated creative, fabrication, production, and operating capabilities positions Memoir as a fuller-service partner for FEC and attraction developers. Operators planning new events or immersive activations should be aware of Memoir's expanded service offerings.

articles.title: LEXRA Executive Director Bob Cooney Spotlighted for Decades of Location-Based VR and Laser Tag Leadership
articles.summary: Bob Cooney, executive director of the Location-Based Entertainment XR Association (LEXRA), is recognized for a career spanning laser tag, location-based VR, and digital entertainment, including founding Laser Storm and working with Edison Brothers on mall-based VR centers. His ongoing advocacy through LEXRA is shaping standards and best practices for XR attractions in FECs. FEC operators adding or upgrading VR and XR attractions should be familiar with LEXRA's resources and Cooney's industry perspective.

articles.title: Merlin Entertainments to Roll Out Virtual Queue Accessibility System in 2027
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments will introduce a new virtual queue-based accessibility system in 2027, replacing its current RAP queuing process with an app-based solution that reduces time guests spend in physical queues. While primarily affecting Merlin's large theme park properties, the technology signals a broader industry direction toward digital queue management for accessibility needs. FEC operators should monitor virtual queue adoption as guest expectations for inclusive, tech-enabled experiences continue to rise.

articles.title: Six Flags Expands 2026 Holiday Events Across 11 Parks with Two New Celebrations
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation is growing its 2026 holiday season program with two new events added to its roster, bringing festive celebrations to 11 theme parks across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, along with special resort holiday packages. The expansion reflects the increasing importance of seasonal programming to regional amusement park revenue. FEC operators should consider how holiday event programming can extend their operating calendar and drive incremental revenue.

articles.title: Six Flags Over Georgia Unveils Immersive 'Holiday in the Park' Experience for 2026 Season
articles.summary: Six Flags Over Georgia is bringing back Holiday in the Park on November 21 with an expanded, immersive format featuring millions of lights, live entertainment, interactive characters, and festive food and beverage offerings. The event illustrates how regional theme parks are elevating seasonal programming with experiential storytelling elements. FEC operators running holiday events can draw inspiration from Six Flags' approach to multi-sensory, interactive seasonal activations.

articles.title: Candy Land NYC Store Opening Turns Classic Board Game into Real-Life Experience
articles.summary: A permanent Candy Land-branded retail and experiential store is opening in November adjacent to the New York Hilton Midtown, translating the beloved Hasbro board game into a walk-through candy wonderland. The concept is an example of IP-driven experiential retail, a format increasingly relevant to FEC operators considering branded entertainment partnerships. Operators and developers tracking the intersection of retail, IP, and location-based entertainment should follow this opening.

articles.title: Maurer Rides Develops 'Transportainment' System Combining Passenger Transit and Entertainment
articles.summary: Maurer Rides has unveiled a new transportation system built on its Spike technology platform, introducing the concept of 'Transportainment' — blending functional passenger movement with entertainment value. While aimed primarily at large parks and destination venues, the innovation points to growing demand for experiential infrastructure that engages guests throughout a facility. FEC designers and large venue operators should watch Transportainment as a potential differentiator for guest flow and experience design.

articles.title: PIXERA Platform Synchronizes 19 Projectors at Czech Digital Art Gallery
articles.summary: The PIXERA media server platform is powering Signal Space, the Czech Republic's largest digital art gallery at nearly 27,000 square feet, keeping 19 projectors in precise synchronization across immersive gallery environments. The deployment highlights the technical capabilities now accessible for mid-scale immersive venues, an increasingly relevant benchmark for FEC operators building out digital art or immersive projection attractions. Venue operators and AV suppliers considering large-scale projection installations should review this case study.

articles.title: Immersive Cinema Production Wraps Filming for Heritage Great Britain Venues
articles.summary: Filming has completed on a new immersive cinema production set to open at Land's End and The Needles in 2027, centered on a lighthouse keeper narrative and now entering post-production. The project reflects growing adoption of immersive cinema as an attraction format for heritage and destination venues. FEC operators exploring cinematic or storytelling-based attraction formats should note this as an example of content-driven immersive experience development.
